I've attached a screenshot of the chunk timing (chunk_trace.png) and one session log that shows repeated 504s and WebSocket keepalive timeouts. Request IDs: req_bL_7f2a, req_bL_7f2b.

This is blocking our internal success metrics and the execs are asking for a root cause. Can you escalate? We need either a mitigation or a rollback to the older routing policy.

Quick triage notes (initial):
- Summary: chunked-transfer sockets appear to be experiencing silent stalls when session concurrency increases; symptoms align with intermittent upstream proxy retransmit/queueing. Not seeing immediate model-level token generation stalls in CPU/GPU logs — token pipeline continues but transport layer stalls.
- Evidence: network-side retransmits in netflow + clustered keepalive resets for the connection window around 09:54-10:05 PDT (matching request ids).

Immediate mitigations we can enact in the next 30-120 minutes:
1) Routing override for BrightLane to Dedicated (cold start ~15 min if we have capacity in us-west-2) — recommended if renewal at risk.
2) Apply temporary socket-keepalive bump and increase chunked-transfer EOL timeout to 70s for their tenant, plus aggressive prefix caching to reduce per-session token pressure.
3) Canary: send a small subset of their sessions through an alternate proxy path with higher keepalive; monitor for disappearance of silence.

I'll open INF-11297 (linked) and assign engineers for an in-depth root cause. If Dedicated is requested, ops will need an approval; Hiro, can you confirm whether we should offer a Dedicated trial (credits) to unblock the demo?

Rishi
